package db_test

import (
	"context"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/launchdarkly/go-sdk-common/v3/ldcontext"
	"github.com/launchdarkly/go-sdk-common/v3/ldvalue"
	"github.com/launchdarkly/ldcli/internal/dev_server/db"
	"github.com/launchdarkly/ldcli/internal/dev_server/model"
)

// Reopening an existing database re-runs migrations; the payload_version
// migration relies on SQLite's "duplicate column name" error text. The
// json_each-based override pruning in UpdateProject must keep working too.
func TestVerifyReopenAndPrune(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "dev_server.db")
	store, err := db.NewSqlite(ctx, path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	p := model.Project{
		Key: "p", SourceEnvironmentKey: "e", Context: ldcontext.New("u"), LastSyncTime: time.Now(), PayloadVersion: 1,
		AllFlagsState: model.FlagsState{
			"keep": {Value: ldvalue.Bool(true), Version: 1},
			"drop": {Value: ldvalue.Bool(true), Version: 1},
		},
	}
	if err := store.InsertProject(ctx, p); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, k := range []string{"keep", "drop"} {
		if _, err := store.UpsertOverride(ctx, model.Override{ProjectKey: "p", FlagKey: k, Value: ldvalue.Bool(false), Active: true}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}

	reopened, err := db.NewSqlite(ctx, path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("reopen (migrations on existing db): %v", err)
	}
	p.AllFlagsState = model.FlagsState{"keep": {Value: ldvalue.Bool(true), Version: 2}}
	if _, err := reopened.UpdateProject(ctx, p); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	overrides, err := reopened.GetOverridesForProject(ctx, "p")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(overrides) != 1 || overrides[0].FlagKey != "keep" {
		t.Fatalf("expected only the 'keep' override to survive pruning, got %+v", overrides)
	}
	got, err := reopened.GetDevProject(ctx, "p")
	if err != nil || got.LastSyncTime.IsZero() {
		t.Fatalf("GetDevProject after reopen: %v %+v", err, got)
	}
}
